description: Loop 5 — Deep security audit, auth hardening, UI/UX improvements, and mobile platform readiness. Covers server-side rate limiting, prompt injection protection, session management, auth event logging, design system centralization, accessibility improvements, and Android platform assessment.

ralphLoop.verdict: Loop 5 initiated — 20 new stories covering critical security gaps (unauthenticated endpoints, missing rate limits, prompt injection), auth hardening (session timeout, event logging, brute force mitigation), UI/UX improvements (design system, accessibility), and data practice improvements.

previousLoops.verdict: All 20 production hardening stories passing. Ship it.
All 24 user stories implemented. Ship it.
Deep audit — all 50 user stories implemented.

userStories.title: Secure send-silent-push endpoint with authentication
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the send-silent-push Edge Function secured with a shared secret so that only pg_cron (or authorized internal callers) can trigger push notifications to all Pro/Pro+ users.
acceptanceCriteria: send-silent-push validates X-Cron-Secret header against CRON_SECRET environment variable
Returns 403 Forbidden with structured log if secret is missing or invalid
Existing pg_cron job must pass the secret header when invoking the function
External callers without the secret receive 403 and no push notifications are sent
Structured logging captures unauthorized access attempts
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Added CRON_SECRET env var validation. X-Cron-Secret header checked before any processing. Returns 403 with structured log distinguishing missing_secret vs invalid_secret. pg_cron must set X-Cron-Secret header to match CRON_SECRET env var.

userStories.title: Add server-side rate limiting to api-commitments endpoint
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the api-commitments Edge Function to enforce per-user rate limiting so that even Pro+ users cannot spam the API and exhaust database resources.
acceptanceCriteria: api-commitments enforces 60 requests per minute per user via Deno KV
Returns 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header when limit exceeded
Rate limit check occurs after authentication but before any database queries
Structured logging captures rate limit violations with userId
GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE all count toward the same rate limit window
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Added Deno KV-based rate limiting (60 req/min/user) matching the pattern from extract-commitments. checkRateLimit() uses sliding window with timestamps array. Rate limit check placed after auth+subscription verification but before URL parsing and database queries. All HTTP methods count toward the same window. Returns 429 with Retry-After header and structured log.

userStories.title: Add prompt injection protection to AI edge functions
userStories.description: As a developer, I need user-supplied text sanitized and isolated in AI prompts to prevent prompt injection attacks that could manipulate commitment extraction or generate fraudulent dispute summaries.
acceptanceCriteria: extract-commitments wraps user text in XML-delimited boundaries (<user_text>...</user_text>) with explicit instruction to treat content as data only
generate-dispute-summary wraps entity name and commitment data in XML-delimited boundaries with data-only instruction
Both functions strip any XML-like tags from user input before wrapping to prevent boundary escape
System prompt explicitly instructs Claude to ignore any instructions within user data boundaries
Structured logging captures sanitization events when suspicious patterns detected
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Both extract-commitments and generate-dispute-summary updated. sanitizeUserInput() strips all XML-like tags via regex to prevent boundary escape. detectSuspiciousPatterns() checks for common prompt injection phrases and logs warnings. System prompts updated with explicit IMPORTANT instruction to treat <user_text>/<user_data> content as data only. User input wrapped in XML boundaries in the message content.

userStories.title: Add client-side session timeout and auth event logging
userStories.description: As a security-conscious user, I need the app to automatically clear my session after 15 minutes of inactivity, and as a developer I need auth events logged for security auditing.
acceptanceCriteria: AuthService tracks lastActivityTimestamp updated on each validAccessToken() call
After 15 minutes of inactivity (no validAccessToken() calls), next call triggers signOut()
Auth events (signIn, signOut, tokenRefresh, sessionTimeout, refreshFailed) logged via AppLogger.auth
SessionTimeoutService created as an actor that monitors inactivity on app foreground
Inactivity timeout is configurable via static constant (default 15 minutes)
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: AuthService.lastActivityTimestamp tracks last validAccessToken() call. Inactivity > 15min triggers automatic signOut with sessionTimeout log. All auth events logged via AppLogger.auth: signIn, signOut, tokenRefresh, sessionTimeout, refreshFailed. SessionTimeoutService.swift created as actor — tracks background entry time and checks timeout on foreground return. Timeout configurable via AuthService.sessionInactivityTimeout static constant (default 900s).

userStories.title: Fix soft delete RLS policies to block modification of deleted rows
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the soft delete RLS policies updated so users cannot UPDATE or DELETE rows that have already been soft-deleted, enforcing the 30-day retention policy.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration updates commitments UPDATE policy to require deleted_at IS NULL
New migration updates commitments DELETE policy to require deleted_at IS NULL
Same restrictions applied to entities table
Users can still read soft-deleted rows (for recovery UI)
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Migration 20260401000000_security_hardening.sql drops broad FOR ALL policies and replaces with granular SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE. UPDATE and DELETE require deleted_at IS NULL. SELECT allows viewing soft-deleted rows for recovery UI.

userStories.title: Add database constraints for data integrity
userStories.description: As a developer, I need missing database constraints added to prevent invalid data from being stored — confidence range, duplicate prevention, and required field enforcement.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration adds CHECK constraint: confidence >= 0 AND confidence <= 10
New migration adds CHECK constraint: dollar_amount >= 0 when not null
New migration adds NOT NULL constraint on entity_name and summary for commitments
Existing data that violates constraints is cleaned up before constraints are applied
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Migration cleans up invalid data first (clamps confidence 0-10, fixes negative dollar_amount), then adds CHECK constraints: chk_confidence_range, chk_dollar_amount_non_negative, chk_entity_name_not_empty, chk_summary_not_empty.

userStories.title: Enable pg_cron hard delete job for GDPR compliance
userStories.description: As a privacy-conscious user, I need soft-deleted data to be permanently removed after 30 days as stated in the privacy policy, enforced by an automated database job.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration creates or replaces the hard_delete_expired function
pg_cron job scheduled to run daily at 3:00 AM UTC
Deletes rows from commitments and entities where deleted_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
Job execution logged to processing_log table
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: hard_delete_expired_records() replaced with version that logs deletion counts to processing_log using device_id='system:hard_delete_cron'. pg_cron schedule command provided (commented, needs uncommenting on Supabase instance). Runs daily at 3:00 AM UTC.

userStories.title: Fix processing_log INSERT policy to require service role
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the processing_log table's INSERT policy tightened so only service role (Edge Functions) can write to it, not any authenticated user.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration drops existing permissive processing_log INSERT policy
New policy restricts INSERT to service role only
Edge Functions using service role key can still insert
Regular authenticated users cannot insert into processing_log
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: Dropped permissive processing_log_service_insert (WITH CHECK (true)). Replaced with processing_log_deny_user_insert (WITH CHECK (false)). Service role bypasses RLS entirely, so Edge Functions still work. Regular authenticated users blocked.

userStories.title: Create centralized design system with semantic tokens
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a centralized DesignSystem.swift that defines all color, spacing, typography, and shape tokens so the app has consistent styling without hardcoded values scattered across views.
acceptanceCriteria: DesignSystem.swift created in Seddly/Sources/Shared/ with semantic color tokens (statusPending, statusFulfilled, statusOverdue, etc.)
Spacing constants defined (xs=4, sm=8, md=12, lg=16, xl=24, xxl=32)
Typography styles defined (titleLarge, titleMedium, body, caption, badge)
Shape constants defined (cardCornerRadius=12, badgeCornerRadius=8, buttonCornerRadius=10)
At least 3 existing views updated to use DesignSystem tokens instead of hardcoded values
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add accessibility hints for swipe actions and complex interactions
userStories.description: As a VoiceOver user, I need accessibility hints on swipe actions, filter controls, and bulk selection so I can effectively use the app without seeing the screen.
acceptanceCriteria: LedgerView swipe actions have .accessibilityHint describing the gesture effect
Filter button has accessibility hint explaining it opens filter panel
Bulk selection mode has accessibility announcements for selection count changes
CommitmentCardView has accessibilityValue showing status and deadline
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add server-side auth event logging table and Edge Function
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a server-side auth_events table that logs sign-in, sign-out, token refresh, and failed auth attempts for security monitoring and incident response.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration creates auth_events table (id, user_id, event_type, ip_address, user_agent, created_at)
RLS policy restricts reads to own user_id, inserts to service role
api-commitments logs auth events (successful auth, failed auth, subscription check failure)
extract-commitments and generate-dispute-summary log auth events
Index on (user_id, created_at) for efficient querying
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: auth_events table created with event_type enum, ip_address, user_agent, details columns. RLS: SELECT own data, INSERT denied for users (service role bypasses). Indexes on (user_id, created_at) and (event_type, created_at). logAuthEvent() helper added to api-commitments, extract-commitments, and generate-dispute-summary. Captures auth_success, auth_failed, auth_missing, subscription_check_failed events.

userStories.title: Add interactive widget support for iOS 17+
userStories.description: As a user, I need to be able to fulfill commitments directly from the widget without opening the app, using iOS 17+ interactive widget capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyWidget adds a Button with AppIntent to fulfill the top overdue commitment
FulfillCommitmentIntent created as an AppIntent that updates SwiftData
Widget refreshes after fulfillment to show next commitment
Haptic feedback on successful fulfillment (via intent response)
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add large widget variant with commitment timeline
userStories.description: As a user, I need a large (systemLarge) widget that shows a mini timeline of upcoming deadlines so I can see my commitment schedule at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: SeddlyWidget adds systemLarge variant to supportedFamilies
Large widget shows up to 5 commitments sorted by deadline
Each entry shows entity name, summary (truncated), deadline date, and status color indicator
Deep links to individual commitment details
Handles empty state with 'No upcoming deadlines' message
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add CORS headers to send-silent-push and subscription-webhook
userStories.description: As a developer, I need consistent CORS handling across all Edge Functions, including proper rejection of cross-origin requests to internal-only endpoints.
acceptanceCriteria: send-silent-push returns empty CORS headers (no Access-Control-Allow-Origin) since it's internal-only
subscription-webhook returns empty CORS headers since it's Apple-initiated only
Both endpoints reject OPTIONS preflight requests with 405
Structured logging captures any unexpected CORS requests to internal endpoints
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add request ID correlation across client and server
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API requests from the iOS app to include a client-generated X-Request-ID header that Edge Functions log alongside their server-side requestId for end-to-end tracing.
acceptanceCriteria: SyncService, AIExtractionService, and DisputeSummaryService add X-Request-ID header to all requests
Request ID is a UUID generated per-request on the client
Edge Functions extract and log X-Request-ID alongside server requestId
Client logs the same request ID via AppLogger for correlation
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add custom button styles and view modifiers to design system
userStories.description: As a developer, I need shared button styles and view modifiers in the design system so buttons, cards, and badges have consistent styling across all views.
acceptanceCriteria: PrimaryButtonStyle, SecondaryButtonStyle, DestructiveButtonStyle created as ButtonStyle conformances
CardModifier created as ViewModifier for consistent card appearance (background, corner radius, shadow)
BadgeModifier created for consistent badge styling (capsule, padding, font)
At least 2 existing views updated to use the new styles
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add Dark Mode color verification and semantic colors
userStories.description: As a user who prefers dark mode, I need all custom colors to have proper dark mode variants so the app is comfortable to use at night.
acceptanceCriteria: DesignSystem colors use Color(uiColor:) with UIColor that responds to trait changes, or use asset catalog colors with Both Appearances
Status colors verified to have sufficient contrast in dark mode (WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio)
Card backgrounds use .secondarySystemGroupedBackground instead of hardcoded colors
All Text elements use primary/secondary system colors for readability
Build succeeds

userStories.title: Add security headers to all Edge Function responses
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all Edge Functions to include standard security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Strict-Transport-Security) in every response.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared securityHeaders function returns X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000
All 5 Edge Functions include security headers in every response (success, error, and CORS preflight)
Cache-Control: no-store added to auth-related responses
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: SECURITY_HEADERS constant added to all 5 Edge Functions + new delete-account function. Includes X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains, Cache-Control: no-store. Spread into all Response constructors.

userStories.title: Add account deletion endpoint and wire to Settings
userStories.description: As a user who wants to delete their account, I need the 'Delete All Data' button in Settings to also delete my server-side data and Supabase auth account, not just local data.
acceptanceCriteria: New delete-account Edge Function that deletes all user data (commitments, entities, privacy_audit_log, custom_workflows) and deactivates the Supabase auth user
Edge Function requires Bearer JWT authentication
SettingsView 'Delete All Data' calls the endpoint for Pro+ users before clearing local data
Confirmation dialog warns that server data deletion is permanent
Signs user out after successful deletion
Build succeeds
userStories.notes: New delete-account Edge Function created. Deletes all user data in order (privacy_audit_log, custom_workflows, auth_events, commitments, entities, user record) then calls supabase.auth.admin.deleteUser(). Bearer JWT required. SettingsView updated: deleteAllData() now async, calls deleteServerAccount() for signed-in Pro+ users first. Confirmation dialog updated with server deletion warning. Signs out after successful deletion. Deploy workflow updated.

userStories.title: Add composite database indexes for common query patterns
userStories.description: As a developer, I need composite indexes on the most common query patterns to improve API response times for Pro+ users with large datasets.
acceptanceCriteria: New migration adds composite index on commitments(user_id, status, deadline) for filtered queries
New migration adds composite index on commitments(user_id, deleted_at) for soft delete queries
New migration adds index on entities(user_id, name) for entity lookup
New migration adds index on auth_events(user_id, created_at) for auth event queries
Build succeeds
